credit_lending_product.label: Credit / lending product
credit_lending_product.value: Merchandise lease-to-own, payroll-deduction purchases, interest-free buy now, pay later installments, and short-term cash advances.

origination_channel.label: Origination channel
origination_channel.value: E-commerce, app-based, and in-store lease origination, employer-sponsored purchase programs, retailer checkout for Four, and direct mobile origination for MoneyApp.

funding_balance_sheet_model.label: Funding / balance-sheet model
funding_balance_sheet_model.value: Progressive Leasing holds lease merchandise on balance sheet and funds operations with operating cash flow and corporate debt.

credit_loss_measure.label: Credit-loss measure
credit_loss_measure.value: Progressive Leasing reports lease merchandise write-offs net of recoveries as a share of lease revenue.

notes: Portfolio yield, delinquency aging, and securitization exposure are uncertain.
